sameLineCorroboration.subject: brandedId<T>()
sameLineCorroboration.explanation: Actual ast-grep found 343 call AST nodes; 24 were a second call on an already-matched file line. pnpm ast callers emitted 319 because the shared emitter deduplicates source-search hits by file+line+kind+rendered line.

confirmedFindings.title: Six query lenses intentionally scan a smaller corpus than the repository can author
confirmedFindings.failure: Package-root TypeScript, package/source MTS, and Playwright TSX are excluded. A positive result is still incomplete, and exports/aliases cannot enter an existing excluded path. The zero-result hint admits this only for name-lookup verbs; positive runs do not announce missing roots beyond the long corpus label.
confirmedFindings.repair: Move these syntactic lenses to the already-existing wide search corpus. The current tree difference is only six files (7,848 standard vs 7,854 wide), so accuracy costs little. Keep typed refs/cycles on native programs and literal on wide.

confirmedFindings.title: Source-query totals collapse distinct AST sites that share one line
confirmedFindings.failure: The emitter deduplicates source hits by file, line, kind, and rendered source line. Two calls/tags/literals on one line become one match, so totals are line counts while help and output call them hits/call sites.
confirmedFindings.live: brandedId: actual ast-grep found 343 call nodes on 319 unique lines; pnpm ast callers reported 319, dropping 24 distinct calls.
confirmedFindings.repair: Carry start offset (or an internal hit id) in Hit and dedupe on node identity. Preserve line-oriented rendering while keeping exact total/matches counts.

confirmedFindings.title: importers answers a spelling query unless the caller already knows the resolved file path
confirmedFindings.failure: The subject is compared as a substring against both raw specifier and resolved absolute path. Asking the documented package-spec form does not canonicalize it to the target, so differently spelled #aliases and relative imports disappear.
confirmedFindings.live: `importers @orb/kit/ids` returned 3,496; `importers packages/kit/src/ids/index.ts` returned 3,502 and recovered four #ids plus two relative imports.
confirmedFindings.repair: Resolve a module-spec subject to canonical target file(s) first, then compare import target identity. Keep an explicit spelling-only mode if substring search remains useful. Resolve static and literal dynamic imports through the same door.

confirmedFindings.title: refs cannot discover several ordinary module-local declaration kinds
confirmedFindings.failure: Declaration discovery includes every exported declaration, but among non-exported declarations only functions and variable declarations. Module-local classes, interfaces, type aliases, enums, and named declarations therefore produce 'no declaration found' even though the native checker could resolve them.
confirmedFindings.repair: Enumerate reference-findable named declarations across the file AST (or use the checker symbol table) and retain origin-node deduplication. Add one positive control per declaration kind and alias/re-export traversal.

confirmedFindings.title: callers and jsx are spelling lenses presented as usage lenses
confirmedFindings.failure: callers matches every same-spelled bare callee/property tail and misses calls through import/local aliases; jsx compares exact tag text and misses renamed bindings/member paths while conflating unrelated same-name components. Neither follows declaration identity.
confirmedFindings.repair: Add identity-resolved callers/jsx using native programs and reuse semanticReferenceNodes; retain current behavior under explicit spelling verbs if needed. Output must label spelling versus identity.

confirmedFindings.title: aliases help text overstates the const-rebinding population
confirmedFindings.failure: The help says const Y = X, but implementation reports it only when Y is exported. Local const rebindings are invisible, as are other alias forms. The command has no dedicated behavior controls.
confirmedFindings.repair: Either enumerate all intended rebindings and classify local/exported, or narrow the contract/help to exported API aliases. Add positive/negative controls for each supported form.

confirmedFindings.title: flow and reaches hard-code the packages tree but do not state that boundary in the answer
confirmedFindings.failure: Dependency-cruiser receives only `packages`, so tests, tooling, scripts, Playwright, and root tools can never appear. Help says every module for reaches, and the epilogue reports the config/pattern with scanned=n/a rather than the actual root set. A zero or partial graph can be mistaken for workspace reachability.
confirmedFindings.live: flow agent-sdk returned 211 edge lines; reaches agent-sdk returned 3,428, both with scanned=n/a. Neither receipt names the hard-coded packages root.
confirmedFindings.repair: Expose and print a governed graph-root scope (production-packages vs workspace), or broaden the default to all authored runtime/test/tooling roots. Keep subprocess failure fail-closed.

confirmedFindings.title: cycles reports DFS back-edge witnesses rather than the closed cycle population
confirmedFindings.failure: Once a node is fully visited, later edges into it cannot produce another cycle. Overlapping simple cycles can collapse to one DFS witness, and the output is traversal-order dependent. There is no direct cycle behavior control.
confirmedFindings.repair: Define the contract as strongly connected components and report each cyclic SCC, or enumerate/canonicalize simple cycles with a bound. Add relative, #alias, barrel, and overlapping-cycle controls.

confirmedFindings.title: The fragile lenses have the thinnest controls
confirmedFindings.failure: There are no direct behavior controls for refs/importers/cycles/aliases; callers is tested only for an absent name; flow/reaches are tested for bad subprocess/argv but not a positive graph. Existing positive controls concentrate on exports, jsx, ident corpus, and literal.
confirmedFindings.repair: Plant tiny in-memory world-aware programs for every semantic claim and one real-process smoke per corpus class. Prove alias traversal, collisions, cross-world references, package-root/MTS/Playwright membership, same-line multiplicity, and depcruise root scope.

recommendedRepairGroups.name: Corpus and count honesty
items: Move six syntactic verbs to wide roots

items: add semantic callers/jsx while retaining explicit spelling modes

recommendedRepairGroups.name: Graph/alias contract
items: settle local vs exported alias taxonomy

limitations: No typed refs/cycles whole-repo command was launched during the concurrent rot sweep; their implementation was traced through the native semantic workspace and their missing controls are explicit.
The live query probes are current-tree snapshots, not deletion verdicts. No source was edited.
Counts from pnpm ast query verbs are their current emitted line-deduplicated counts; GQ-002 explains why they are not AST occurrence totals.
